request.objective: Start at https://www.flightaware.com/. Compare available plans for the AeroAPI on Flightaware.

result.excerpt:
FlightAware's AeroAPI comes in three tiers — **Personal, Standard and Premium** — and none of them carries a flat subscription price. The plan cards only offer "Get started"; what you pay is per query, and the two paid tiers add a monthly minimum. Side by side, from the comparison table on the AeroAPI page:

| | Personal | Standard | Premium |
|---|---|---|---|
| How you're charged | Per-query usage fees, up to **$5 free per month** ($10/month if you feed ADS-B) | Per-query usage fees, subject to a monthly minimum | Per-query usage fees, subject to a monthly minimum |
| Monthly minimum | None | **$100/month** | **$1,000/month** |
| Result-set rate limit | 10 result sets/minute | 5 result sets/second | 100 result sets/second |
| Historical result sets | Not included | 500,000/month | 500,000/month |
| Volume discounting | Not included | Included | Included |
| Uptime guarantee | — | — | 99.5% |
| Support | — | Email | Email + phone |
| Invoicing | — | — | Yes |
| Permitted use | Storage and distribution of derivative works for personal or academic purposes only | Business and business-to-consumer purposes | Business, B2C commercial, and all B2B commercial purposes |

Included on top of the base: static maps and imagery in all three tiers; Flight Alerts and Historical Flight Data from Standard up; FlightAware Foresight and Aireon space-based ADS-B only on Premium (both marked with an asterisk — you contact FlightAware to have them enabled, and use restrictions apply). Internal use for personal purposes and academic use are allowed on every tier; internal business use and B2C commercialization start at Standard; B2B commercialization is Premium only.
